pages.title: Silk Moths
pages.text: Silk Moths are delicate magical insects found in forests, essential for producing silk-based resources. They may also be summoned through $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual#sacrifice)Nature's Ritual$(/l), which requires a soul sacrifice.

pages.title: Behavior
pages.text: Silk Moths are fragile and drawn to light. They will hover around light sources when present, and wander or rest when none are nearby. Different variants can be found in the wild.

pages.title: Breeding
pages.text: Silk Moths can be bred using Fragrant Nectar, which is crafted using the $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/mortar_and_pestle)Mortar and Pestle$(/l).

pages.title: Lifecycle
pages.text: Moths lay Egg Clusters on leaves or Nesting Blocks. These hatch into Silkworms, which can be placed on logs to form cocoons.

pages.title: Cocoons
pages.text: Silkworm Cocoons form on logs and can be found naturally on certain trees. They can be broken to release a silkworm, or activated with light to produce a Silk Moth.

pages.title: Silk Resources
pages.text: Silk Moths and their lifecycle produce Silk Fiber, a key material used in crafting. Silkworms can also be processed to obtain additional fiber.

pages.title: On Use
pages.text: Silk Moths form the foundation of silk production. With proper setup, they can be farmed for a steady supply of materials used in rituals and crafting.
